verdict.rationale: Plaid's Identity product is documented to return the name, mailing address, phone number and email on file with the user's bank. That covers the ops lead's need to pull account-holder details for matching against their own customer record. missing for 10: documentation of a matching or comparison capability (e.g. match scores against supplied customer data), independent hands-on corroboration, and detail on per-account owner data structure or coverage across institutions.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer

citations.quote: Using Identity, you can access a user's phone number, email address, mailing address, and name.
Plaid's Identity product helps you verify users' identities by accessing information on file with their financial institution.
